gloss: lower body, lower half of the body

definitions.gloss: lower body, lower half of the body
definitions.explanation: The part of the body below the waist, including the hips, legs, and feet.

examples.english: I have no sensation in my lower body due to anesthesia.

examples.japanese: {下半身|かはんしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{冷|ひ}えない→冷える：01154_hieru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}をつけて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful not to let your lower body get cold.

notes:
{下半身|かはんしん} refers to the lower half of the body, from the waist down, including the hips, legs, and feet. It is commonly used in fitness, medical, and sports contexts to describe exercises, injuries, or physical conditions affecting the lower body.
